title: Dashboard grid
summary: Top bar, sidebar and a board of cards where some span two columns or rows.
brief: At 1024px wide: the top bar spans the full width. Under it, a 220px sidebar sits beside the board, and both reach the bottom of the page.
The board is a grid of three equal columns with 16px between cards. The Revenue card spans two columns; the Activity card spans two rows.
At 375px wide everything stacks in a single column.
hints: Two grids, one inside the other: .dashboard frames the page (top bar, sidebar, board), and .board lays out the cards.
A card covers more than one track with span: grid-column: span 2 on the wide card, grid-row: span 2 on the tall one.
Rows need a height to span: grid-auto-rows: minmax(120px, auto) on .board. For phones, a media query that sets one column, and resets the spans (grid-column: auto; grid-row: auto).
solutionNotes: The page is a two-column grid whose areas are drawn as a picture; the board is a second, independent grid for the cards. span 2 makes an item cover two tracks (the 16px gap between them is included in its size). The spanning cards would create extra implicit tracks on a phone, so the media query resets grid-column and grid-row as well as the column count.
